reference.title: WHO global air quality guidelines: particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10), ozone, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide
reference.note: Guideline only — not a regulatory limit.

parameterDefinition.name: PM10
parameterDefinition.description: Inhalable particulate matter mass concentration. Annual means apply for long-term criterion.
parameterDefinition.measurementMethod: See WHO AQG 2021 section 3.3.1.1 (page 116) for method description.

criteria.methodNote: Recommended annual mean AQG level for long-term PM10 exposure. Source: WHO AQG 2021, section 3.3.1.1, p.116 (Table 3.7).

evidenceReference.quote: The recommendation is an annual PM10 AQG level of 15 µg/m3.

curation.curationNotes: Curated annual PM10 criterion from WHO AQG 2021 with threshold from section 3.3.1.1 and Table 3.7 (page 116).

validation.validationNotes: Evidence aligns with WHO AQG 2021 section 3.3.1.1 (p.116): annual PM10 AQG value = 15 µg/m3. Independent validation remains pending; therefore this record is not approved for use as a core criterion.
